[cli:claude] Add a short line of evening-specific reassurances to the hero, such as 'Private booth with lamp & USB-C · No calls in the study area · Free hot milk after 22:00 · 6 min to metro, staff until 02:00'. Also turn the 'REPLY NIGHT ↗' block into a clearly labelled action, such as 'Copy NIGHT & open official account', so the first screen answers the visitor's worries and the next step is unambiguous.

first_impression.evidence: Work or classes by day? Prepare for graduate-school, civil-service or certification exams in a quiet space at night.
first_impression.why: The first screen names the audience, the hours, the ¥129 trial for the first 50 and a 'REPLY NIGHT' action, which meets the 7 anchor; it misses 8+ because the headline 'Study by night. Move forward.' is generic, nothing about the booths, quiet or 22:00 milk shows above the fold, and the 'REPLY NIGHT ↗' bar is styled like a button but is really a keyword to send, so what tapping it does is unclear.

layout.evidence: Settle in. Get into your work.
layout.why: The page flows from the hero offer card to a three-column benefit grid, a logistics row and a closing CTA with two numbered steps, so the eye moves from offer to details to action; it falls short of 10 because the location and safety row ('Close to the metro' / 'Stay focused into the night') has no eyebrow and small text, so it looks like an afterthought, and the left side of the desktop hero leaves a lot of empty space.

visual_craft.why: The deep green, cream and gold palette, serif display headings with sans body text, and consistent cards and dividers suit a calm night study room; it is held back from 8 by small, low-contrast grey body text on dark green in the feature and logistics blocks, and by an all-text treatment with no imagery or icons that looks restrained rather than finished like a product page.

mobile.why: On the phone the page is a clean single column with comfortable text sizes, and the price card and full-width 'REPLY NIGHT' block fall within roughly the first screen; it is a straight collapse of the desktop layout with nothing phone-first (for example no sticky CTA), the block's tap action is unclear, and the screenshot ends at the perk section, so the closing CTA on mobile can't be checked.

persuasion.evidence: Trial offer limited to the first 50 sign-ups.
persuasion.why: Every fact in the brief is used and several are framed around the visitor ('Calls have their own space', 'A little comfort after 22:00', 'Bring your books and plug in'), the trial terms, the later ¥199 price and the two-step join are clear, and the urgency is honest; it misses 8+ because the safety and metro details, which are the main worry for someone leaving at 02:00, are listed like a spec sheet under the weak heading 'Stay focused into the night', and the hero never speaks to the after-work tiredness of a day worker.

Every price, time, number and perk on th.why: ¥129, ¥199, first 50, 18:00–02:00, 42 booths, lamp + 2 sockets + USB-C, 4 phone booths, milk/soy milk after 22:00, key card after 01:30, staff until 02:00, second floor, 6 minutes' walk and the keyword NIGHT all match the brief. There are no testimonials, ratings, member counts or extra perks, and 'Every day' is also in the brief.

The page has no placeholder text, broken.why: Both screenshots render cleanly with no lorem ipsum, overflow or overlap. Joined strings like 'REPLYNIGHT↗' appear only in the extracted text; on screen the label and keyword are spaced correctly.

judge_details.top_fix: Add a short line of evening-specific reassurances to the hero, such as 'Private booth with lamp & USB-C · No calls in the study area · Free hot milk after 22:00 · 6 min to metro, staff until 02:00'. Also turn the 'REPLY NIGHT ↗' block into a clearly labelled action, such as 'Copy NIGHT & open official account', so the first screen answers the visitor's worries and the next step is unambiguous.
